brief_title: Study of BMS-936558 (Nivolumab) Compared to Docetaxel in Previously Treated Advanced or Metastatic Squamous Cell Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) (CheckMate 017)
official_title: An Open-Label Randomized Phase III Trial of BMS-936558 (Nivolumab) Versus Docetaxel in Previously Treated Advanced or Metastatic Squamous Cell Non-small Cell Lung Cancer
conditions: Squamous Cell Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

arms.label: Arm A: Nivolumab
arms.description: Nivolumab 3 mg/kg solution intravenously (IV) every 2 weeks until documented disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

arms.label: Arm B: Docetaxel
arms.description: Docetaxel 75 mg/m^2 concentrate for solution for intravenous infusion every 3 weeks until documented disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

inclusion_criteria: Men and women >= 18 years of age
Histologically or cytologically-documented squamous cell NSCLC with Stage IIIB/IV disease or recurrent/progressive disease following multimodal therapy
Disease recurrence or progression during/after one prior platinum doublet-based chemotherapy regimen for advanced or metastatic disease
Measurable disease by CT/MRI per RECIST 1.1 criteria
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status <= 1
FFPE tumor tissue block or unstained slides available for biomarker evaluation, received by central lab prior to randomization
exclusion_criteria: Untreated CNS metastases (eligible if treated and neurologically stable for >= 2 weeks, off corticosteroids or on stable/decreasing dose <= 10 mg daily prednisone)
Active, known or suspected autoimmune disease (exceptions: type I diabetes, hypothyroidism on replacement, skin disorders not requiring systemic treatment)
Condition requiring systemic treatment with corticosteroids or other immunosuppressive medications within 14 days of randomization
Prior therapy with anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, anti-PD-L2, anti-CD137, or anti-CTLA-4 antibody (including ipilimumab)
Symptomatic interstitial lung disease that may interfere with detection/management of drug-related pulmonary toxicity
Treatment with any investigational agent within 14 days of first administration of study treatment

primary_outcomes.measure: Overall Survival (OS) Time in Months for All Randomized Participants at Primary Endpoint
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Randomization until 199 deaths, up to November 2014

primary_outcomes.measure: Overall Survival (OS) Rate in All Randomized Participants
Number of Deaths From Any Cause in All Randomized Participants at Primary Endpoint

secondary_outcomes.measure: Objective Response Rate (ORR) in All Randomized Participants
secondary_outcomes.time_frame: From date of randomization up to date of objective disease progression

secondary_outcomes.measure: Progression-Free Survival (PFS) Time in Months for All Randomized Participants
secondary_outcomes.time_frame: From randomization up to first confirmed response

secondary_outcomes.measure: Duration of Objective Response (DOR) in Months for All Confirmed Responders
secondary_outcomes.time_frame: From date of first confirmed response to date of progression
